{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm sentinel value is -999.0 and count occurrences
sentinel_value = -999.0
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()

# Check how many rows have sentinel values
print(f"Number of sentinel values (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check if any other sentinel values are present (e.g., 0, -1, etc.)
other_sentinels = df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([0, -1, -2, -1000, -999.1]).sum()
print(f"Other potential sentinel values (0, -1, -2, -1000, -999.1): {other_sentinels}")

# Check distribution of sentinel values across key variables
sentinel_mask = df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value
sentinel_data = df[senital_mask]

print("\nDistribution of sentinel values by arm:")
print(sentinel_data['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nDistribution of sentinel values by site:")
print(sentinel_data['site'].value_counts())

print("\nDistribution of sentinel values by severity:")
print(sentinel_data['severity'].value_counts())"}
